company.name: Bankiom
company.shortDescription: Bankiom is a fintech app offering digital accounts, payments, transfers, and prepaid card services.
company.description: Bankiom is a digital bank that allows customers to open a current account and quickly download a virtual debit card on your smartphone. Bankiom is a UAE-based fintech app that provides a digital alternative to traditional banking through virtual prepaid cards, money transfers, and account management tools. It allows users to quickly create accounts, connect multiple bank accounts, send and receive money, and track spending through a mobile-first platform designed for simple, secure financial control and everyday payments.

productsAndServices.description: A virtual prepaid card that can be obtained quickly and used for online and offline transactions without exchange fees, with features to manage and control card usage.

productsAndServices.description: A platform feature that connects and consolidates multiple bank accounts into one app, providing transaction tracking, spending insights, and easy top-ups.

productsAndServices.description: A virtual prepaid card designed for children and teens, managed by parents to teach financial responsibility through controlled spending and online transaction tracking.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,005,001 to $5,193,004, a 2.59x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 59 (-3 over 90 days) and market heat at 47 (-8).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
